from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import asdict

from django.db import connection, transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from apps.audit.application.system_audit_outbox_observability import (
    GetSystemAuditOutboxBacklogCommand,
    GetSystemAuditOutboxBacklogUseCase,
)
from apps.audit.infrastructure.system_audit_outbox_repository import DjangoSystemAuditOutboxRepository
from apps.audit.infrastructure.system_audit_models import SystemAuditEventModel
from apps.data_center.infrastructure.catalog_models import DatasetPublicationPolicyModel
from core.integration.system_audit_runtime_config import load_system_audit_runtime_config

with transaction.atomic():
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
        cursor.execute("SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s'")
        cursor.execute("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s'")
    observed_at = timezone.now()
    backlog = GetSystemAuditOutboxBacklogUseCase(DjangoSystemAuditOutboxRepository()).execute(
        GetSystemAuditOutboxBacklogCommand(as_of=observed_at)
    )
    runtime = load_system_audit_runtime_config(environment="production")
    policies = list(DatasetPublicationPolicyModel.objects.filter(
        dataset_key="equity.valuation.fact", active=True
    ).values("dataset_key", "contract_version", "schema_version", "minimum_coverage_ratio", "required_evidence"))
    result = {
        "operation": "AUD-03 read-only backlog and DATA-02 valuation policy prerequisites",
        "observed_at": observed_at.isoformat(),
        "transaction_mode": "REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY",
        "outbox_snapshot": asdict(backlog),
        "oldest_backlog_age_seconds": backlog.oldest_backlog_age_seconds,
        "system_event_count": SystemAuditEventModel.objects.count(),
        "runtime": {
            "mode": runtime.mode,
            "outbox_enabled": runtime.outbox_enabled,
            "selector_is_none": runtime.authority_selector is None,
            "snapshot_id": runtime.snapshot_id,
            "snapshot_hash": runtime.snapshot_hash,
        },
        "active_valuation_policies": policies,
        "limitations": [
            "No dispatch, claim, lease renewal, migration, recovery, archive, restore or runtime activation.",
            "A backlog snapshot does not prove HTTP metrics, alerts, TUI, event replay or production acceptance.",
            "No process-local metrics are substituted for production HTTP scrape evidence.",
        ],
    }
print(json.dumps(result, default=str, sort_keys=True))
